description: Change the title or text of an existing post — 'make the text shorter', 'add the opening hours'. Read the post first and pass the NEW text complete, in the user's language. With media_ids you attach images (they replace the current ones); without it images stay. Date and brand stay. Nothing is posted.

media_ids.description: The post's images in order (ids from list_media); the first is the cover. REPLACES the current images.

text.description: The new text, complete (up to 5000 characters).

name: update_social_post
title: Change social post
